content.title: Atletico vs Barcelona 1-2 (3-2 agg): Champions League – as it happened
content.text: 14 Apr 2026 - 21:45 (21:45 GMT)Goodbye for nowThat’s it for our live coverage of Atletico Madrid vs Barcelona in the Champions League.The last four are starting to take shape, with Atleti and PSG booking their slots in the semifinals.On Wednesday evening, we will find out who they will be facing. Be sure to join us back here for live text commentary of Bayern Munich vs Real Madrid, with updates on Sporting’s trip to Arsenal.But for now, from me, Adam Hancock, and my colleague, Patrick Keddie, goodbye.14 Apr 2026 - 21:42 (21:42 GMT)‘Luck wasn’t on our side’Barcelona’s Frenkie de Jong has been speaking with UEFA after the match:“We played a very good match. We gave it our all. I have the feeling that luck wasn’t on our side. I think we’re growing, and that we have a young, talented team that can compete for everything. We’re going to keep going like this.”14 Apr 2026 - 21:37 (21:37 GMT)‘It was a rollercoaster’Atleti goalscorer Ademola Lookman has been speaking with TNT Sports. Here is what he said:“It was a rollercoaster, with us going 2-0 down, and then it was a game of two halves, really. We stuck in there, and we got through to the semis.”On the impact that Lopez’s injury had on the game: “As the game is going on, you are playing and the momentum changes and moments happen and then the pause [for the injury] – it kind of switched us back into gear, and we were able to create a few chances, and we got the goal, and we tried to continue in that way in the second half.”14 Apr 2026 - 21:36 (21:36 GMT)Match reportYou can read more about tonight’s thrilling game in Madrid in our match report, which has just gone live, here.14 Apr 2026 - 21:33 (21:33 GMT)Barcelona’s Budapest dream ends14 Apr 2026 - 21:27 (21:27 GMT)Next up for Atletico MadridDiego Simeone’s side have the small matter of a Copa del Rey final on the horizon.They face Real Sociedad in Seville on Saturday, before an away game at Elche in the league next Wednesday.They’ll then face Athletic Club in Madrid on Saturday, April 25, in La Liga before the first leg of their semifinal at Metropolitano Stadium.14 Apr 2026 - 21:24 (21:24 GMT)14 Apr 2026 - 21:21 (21:21 GMT)PSG ease past LiverpoolThe defending champions are into the final four after winning 2-0 at Anfield to knock Liverpool out.PSG led 2-0 after the first leg, and had to ride out a spell of Liverpool pressure in the second half.The Reds were awarded a penalty after Alexis Mac Allister went down in the box, but the referee changed his decision after reviewing the pitch-side monitor.Ousmane Dembele broke the deadlock after 72 minutes, and he capped off a strong performance with a second goal in stoppage time.Get instant alerts and updates based on your interests. Be the first to know when big stories happen.14 Apr 2026 - 21:18 (21:18 GMT)14 Apr 2026 - 21:15 (21:15 GMT)A return to the semifinalsAtletico’s victory books them a spot in the last four of the Champions League for the first time since 2017.Back then, they faced city rivals Real Madrid and lost 4-2 on aggregate.This time around, they will face either Arsenal or Sporting. The Gunners lead 1-0 after the first leg of that tie, and the teams will meet again at Emirates Stadium on Wednesday evening.
